name: Resurrection Signet
concise_description: Signet. Resurrects target party member (100% Health, 25% Energy). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

name: Signet of Capture
concise_description: Signet. Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.

name: Lightbringer Signet
concise_description: Signet. You gain {{AdrenalineGain}} strikes of adrenaline and {{EnergyGain}} Energy if you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon.

name: Lightbringer's Gaze
concise_description: Skill. Target demonic servant of Abaddon takes 100 holy damage and is interrupted. Hits one additional foe in the area for each rank of Lightbringer you have attained. This skill is disabled (15 seconds).

name: Sunspear Rebirth Signet
concise_description: Signet. Resurrect target dead ally [sic] at your location (full Health and 10% Energy for each Sunspear Rank attained). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

name: Air of Superiority
concise_description: Skill. ({{Duration}} seconds). Gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.

name: Asuran Scan
concise_description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You cannot miss target foe. If you kill this foe, you lose 5% Death Penalty.

name: Mental Block
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have a 50% chance to block. Renewal: every time an enemy hits you.

name: Mindbender
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You move {{SpeedBoostPercent}}% faster and cast Spells 20% faster.

name: Pain Inverter
concise_description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Deals {{PercentOfDamage}}% of the damage (maximum 80) back to target foe every time it does damage.

name: Radiation Field
concise_description: Ward Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration to foes in the area. End effect: inflicts Disease condition ({{DiseaseDuration}} seconds) to foes in the area.

name: Smooth Criminal
concise_description: Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Disables one Spell. This skill becomes that Spell. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy.

name: Summon Ice Imp
concise_description: Spell. Summon a level {{IceImpLevel}} Ice Imp ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Mursaat
concise_description: Spell. Summon a level {{MursaatLevel}} Mursaat ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Naga Shaman
concise_description: Spell. Summon a level {{NagaShamanLevel}} Naga Shaman ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Ruby Djinn
concise_description: Spell. Summon a level {{RubyDjinnLevel}} Ruby Djinn ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Technobabble
concise_description: Spell. Deals {{Damage}} damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Dazed condition ({{DazedDuration}} seconds) on these foes if target was not a boss.

name: "By Ural's Hammer!"
concise_description: Shout. (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal {{IncreasedDamagePercent}}% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.

name: "Don't Trip!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Prevents knock-down; affects party members within earshot.

name: Alkar's Alchemical Acid
concise_description: Spell. Projectile: deals {{Damage}} damage to target and adjacent foes. Deals {{AdditionalDamage}} more damage and inflicts Cracked Armor condition ({{CrackedArmorDuration}} seconds) to Destroyers.

name: Black Powder Mine
concise_description: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals {{FireDamage}} damage. Inflicts Blindness and Bleeding conditions ({{BlindAndBleedingDuration}} seconds). Easily interrupted.

name: Brawling Headbutt
concise_description: Touch Skill. Deals {{Damage}} damage; causes knock-down.

name: Breath of the Great Dwarf
concise_description: Spell. Removes burning and heals for {{Healing}} Health. Affects party members.

name: Drunken Master
concise_description: Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You move and attack {{SpeedIncreasePercentIfSober}}% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack {{SpeedIncreasePercentIfDrunk}}% faster if you are drunk.

name: Dwarven Stability
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your stances last {{StanceDurationIncreasePercent}}% longer. You cannot be knocked-down if you activated this skill while drunk . [sic]

name: Ear Bite
concise_description: Touch Skill. Deals {{PiercingDamage}} piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds).

name: Great Dwarf Armor
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) +24 armor and +60 maximum Health. Additional +24 armor against Destroyers.

name: Great Dwarf Weapon
concise_description: Weapon Spell. (20 seconds.) +{{PlusDamage}} weapon damage and {{KnockDownChancePercent}}% chance to cause knock-down with attacks. Cannot self-target.

name: Light of Deldrimor
concise_description: Spell. Deals {{HolyDamage}} holy damage to foes in the area. Pings hidden objects within the area on the compass.

name: Low Blow
concise_description: Touch Skill. Deals {{Damage}} damage. Inflicts {{ConditionalDamage}} damage and Cracked Armor ({{CrackedArmorDuration}} seconds) if target foe is knocked down.

name: Snow Storm
concise_description: Spell. Deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.

name: Deft Strike
concise_description: Ranged Attack. Deals {{ArmorMinusIgnoringDamage}} damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Courage
concise_description: Ward Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Allies in this ward have +24 armor and +24 more armor against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor
concise_description: Ward Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Allies in this ward deal +{{PlusDamage}} damage and +{{PlusDamageVsCharr}} more damage against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom
concise_description: Ward Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Spells that allies in this ward cast have a {{HsrChancePercent}}% chance to recharge 50% faster. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Escape
concise_description: Spell. Heals you and target ally for {{Healing}}. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. Cannot self-target.

name: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support
concise_description: Spell. Summon a level {{AssassinLevel}} assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike; it Shadow Steps to this foe. If this foe is a Charr, the assassin lives for {{DurationVsCharr}} seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for {{DurationVsOtherFoes}} seconds.

name: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support
concise_description: Spell. Deals {{PiercingDamage}} piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds). 10% chance of +{{AdditionalPiercingDamage}} piercing damage. 25% chance of +540...900 piercing damage if target foe is a Charr.

name: Signet of Infection
concise_description: Signet. Inflicts Diseased condition {{DiseaseDuration}} seconds if target foe is Bleeding.

name: Sneak Attack
concise_description: Melee Attack. Inflicts Blindness ({{BlindDuration}} seconds). Counts as a lead attack.

name: Tryptophan Signet
concise_description: Signet. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target and adjacent foes move and attack {{SpeedReductionPercent}}% slower.

name: Weakness Trap
concise_description: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals {{LightningDamage}} lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{WeaknessDuration}} seconds). Knocks-down Charr. Easily interrupted.

name: Winds
concise_description: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Creates a level {{Level}} spirit ({{Duration}} second lifespan.) Affects foes within range. 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks.

name: "Dodge This!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your next attack is unblockable and deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage.

name: "Finish Him!"
concise_description: Shout. Deals {{Damage}} damage and inflicts Cracked Armor and Deep Wound conditions ({{CrackedArmorAndDeepWoundDuration}} seconds). No effect unless target foe has less than 50% Health.

name: "I Am Unstoppable!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +24 armor and cannot be knocked-down or Crippled.

name: "I Am the Strongest!"
concise_description: Shout. Your next {{OfAttacks}} attacks deal +{{AdditionalDamage}} damage.

name: "You Are All Weaklings!"
concise_description: Shout. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{WeaknessDuration}} seconds). Also affects adjacent foes.

name: "You Move Like a Dwarf!"
concise_description: Shout. Deals {{Damage}} damage, causes knock-down, and inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds).

name: A Touch of Guile
concise_description: Touch Hex Spell. Deals {{ArmorMinusIgnoringDamage}} damage. Target foe cannot attack ({{Duration}} seconds) if it was knocked-down.

name: Club of a Thousand Bears
concise_description: Melee Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamagePerFoe}} damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). Causes knock-down if target foe is non-human.

name: Feel No Pain
concise_description: Skill. (30 seconds.) You have +{{PlusHealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration. You have +{{ConditionalPlusMaximumHealth}} maximum Health if you are drunk when activating this skill.

name: Raven Blessing
concise_description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the Raven (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, {{MaximumHealth}} Health, and a {{BlockChancePercent}}% block chance.

name: Ursan Blessing
concise_description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills, and you have 100 armor and {{MaximumHealth}} Health.

name: Volfen Blessing
concise_description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, {{MaximumHealth}} Health and {{PlusHealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration.
